title: UAlbany men's basketball releases 2025-26 nonconference schedule - NewsBreak
text:
By Adam Shinder ,
14 hours ago UAlbany head coach Dwayne Killings during a game against New Hampshire on Saturday, Feb. 22, 2025, at the Broadway Center in Albany, NY. (Jim Franco/Times Union) The University at Albany men’s basketball program announced its 14-game nonconference slate for the 2025-26 season. The slate is bookended by a pair of games against high-major opponents, includes a three-game trip to Quebec over Thanksgiving weekend and features just three home games at Broadview Center.
UAlbany’s nonconference slate starts with a Nov. 3 trip to Milwaukee to face the Big East’s Marquette in a homecoming for Great Danes coach Dwayne Killings, who was an assistant coach for the Golden Eagles from 2018-21 before being hired at UAlbany.
The Great Danes’ other game against a power conference opponent falls on Dec. 30, when they wrap up their pre-America East slate with a visit to South Carolina of the SEC for the first-ever meeting between the two programs.
After opening against Marquette, UAlbany will visit UMass on Nov. 8 for the program’s third meeting with the Minutemen since 2022. Three days later, on Nov. 11, the Great Danes will open up their home slate by welcoming SUNY Delhi to Broadview Center, followed by a Nov. 14 game at Rhode Island.
The matchup with SUNY Delhi is one of only three nonconference home games for the Great Danes this season. The others come Nov. 18 against Paul Smith’s College and Dec. 21 against Cornell — the only Division I nonconference opponent to visit Broadview Center this season.
As was announced last month, UAlbany will kick off a new four-year contract with Siena to continue the Albany Cup rivalry, with this year’s edition to be held Nov. 21 on the Saints’ home floor at MVP Arena.
Following that, UAlbany heads to Laval, Quebec for three games over Thanksgiving weekend. The Great Danes will play Colgate on Nov. 28 and Fordham on Nov. 29 as part of the Northern Classic multi-team event, then round out their trip Nov. 30 with a neutral-site game in Laval against SUNY Oneonta.
The Great Danes’ December schedule starts with a Dec. 6 trip to New York City to face Columbia, followed by a meeting with Yale — which is coached by former UAlbany player and assistant coach James Jones — in the MGM Springfield Basketball Hall of Fame Classic on Dec. 10 in Springfield, Mass.
Following that, UAlbany visits Florida Atlantic on Dec. 13, then heads to Long Island to face SUNY rival Stony Brook on Dec. 17 before the Cornell and South Carolina games conclude the nonconference slate.
UAlbany’s 16-game America East slate, which was announced back in August, starts Jan. 3 at UMass Lowell, with the home conference opener coming a week later against defending league champion Bryant.
